subject: Junior Project Manager application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Central Vic Civil team,

I'm applying for the Junior Project Manager role in Ballarat that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, tracking procurement and materials and writing progress reports.

Your advert asks for a recent civil graduate who can help with programming, cost tracking, documentation and subcontractor coordination on water, roadworks and land development jobs, which is the work I want to grow into. I'm based in Melton VIC with a licence, my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I don't have Australian civil construction experience yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Central Vic Civil is a locally owned, family operated business delivering sewer and water infrastructure, roadworks and land development across regional Victoria for state and local government and local developers.
letter.subject: Junior Project Manager, Ballarat
letter.greeting: Dear Central Vic Civil Hiring Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Project Manager role in Ballarat advertised on SEEK. Helping plan and track water, roadworks and land development projects alongside experienced project managers is the career path I want, and a regional contractor working for councils and developers is the right place to start it.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, passed on work priorities, tracked progress and kept the client up to date. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

I am based in Melton VIC with an Australian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not yet worked in Australian civil construction, so I would start at junior level and learn your systems quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
